structured.answer: Everything I read on this page is marked 'לא מחושב'. Structured deposits, foreign-currency and dollar-linked deposits, savings policies, ביטוח מנהלים, corporate bonds, gold and more are not calculated yet because the rules are 'עוד בבדיקה'. So I can't use the site to compare them with my deposits yet, and I'll ask my son or the bank. I didn't read to the end.
